proven: The package contains 16 public or official source records, 12 distinct Alice work candidates and 9 public local audit anchors.
With no exact title, clip, actor or scene marker, the local audit retains the complete candidate set and emits UNKNOWN_ALICE_REFERENT_CANDIDATE_SET_RETAINED.
The raw user expression 'schlecht gemacht' is preserved as USER_REPORTED_SOURCE_INPUT without an automatic narrative-mechanism classification.
Seventeen local Node.js tests passed for exact-ID resolution, fail-closed validation, candidate selection and the formal derivation-review gate.
falsified: A shared Alice name or dark story motif is sufficient for the local oracle to select one exact work.
A case-insensitive or approximate candidate identifier is accepted as an exact referent.
Even a complete synthetic review-prerequisite triple automatically proves copying, ownership or a legal entitlement.

counterhypothesis: The phrase describes a different Alice work, a specific episode absent from the finite catalog, or a combination of remembered motifs rather than any one currently listed candidate.

next_recursive_level: Bind one exact distinguishing marker to a registered source, select exactly one candidate if the marker resolves uniquely, and compare only that work's source-bound narrative mechanism.
next_safe_experiment: Add one public exact marker to the source registry and rerun the local CLI with the exact candidate ID; preserve all nonselected candidates and the previous unknown outcome.
stop_condition: Stop before guessing one Alice referent, treating fiction as an external fact, inferring copying or influence from motif similarity, assigning ownership or legal rights, exposing private material, contacting third parties or mutating an external system.
critical_proof_condition: A formal derivation review requires an earlier independently time-bound local artifact, a distinctive function-level match and an access or transfer receipt; satisfying that gate still does not automatically prove copying, ownership or legal entitlement.
boundary: Local execution over eight owned audit package and report files plus already captured public source references; zero external network activity and zero source-system effects during this cycle.
reopen_trigger: An exact public title, clip, actor, episode, scene, quoted line, new official candidate source or a consented source-to-target provenance receipt.
